CORAM:
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ANISH DAYAL  ORDER % 20.03.2023 CRL.M.A. 7214/2023 (Exemption)
1. Exemption is allowed subject to all just exceptions.
2. Application is disposed of.

1. This petition has been filed for quashing of FIR No.750/2016 registered under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC at PS Hari Nagar, New Delhi, on the ground that the parties have settled their disputes vide MOU dated 23.11.2017, which is on record of this Court.
2. The petitioner No.1 and respondent No.2 were married on 24.07.2015.
No child was born out of the wedlock and due to differences between the parties, the marriage has resulted into a divorce vide a decree dated 07.04.2018.

As per the settlement, a balance amount of Rs.3 Lakhs is to be paid at this stage to respondent No.2, which is being tendered by petitioner No.1 vide a DD No.801686 dated 16.03.2023 for Rs.3,00,000/- drawn on Punjab & Sind Bank, and has been handed over to the Special Power of Attorney holder Mr. Mohinder Pal Singh, who received it on behalf of respondent No.2 in the Court and duly acknowledged.
3. Petitioner Nos.1 & 2 are present in the Court, duly identified by the counsel and the IO.
Petitioner Nos. 3 & 4 are exempted from personal appearance on oral request of the learned counsel for the petitioners being other family members of petitioner No.1.

sentences.text: Considering the above settlement between the parties and the chances of conviction of the petitioners being remote and bleak, there is no use continuing with proceedings of the present FIR as it would be a misuse of the process of the Court and an unnecessary burden on the State exchequer.
Accordingly, the petition is allowed.
Consequently, the FIR No.750/2016 registered under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC at PS Hari Nagar, New Delhi, and proceedings emanating therefrom are quashed.
Parties shall abide by the terms of settlement.
5. Accordingly, the petition is disposed of. Pending applications, if any, are disposed of as infructuous.
6. Order be uploaded on the website of this Court.
